1. Bedevil can kill one creature (costs {B}{B}{R})
2. Trading Post could make goats or gain life
3. I could just take the damage and swing back with Spine for lethal

Actually, I could kill Kess with Bedevil before damage, reducing damage by 3. Or I could kill Zetalpa reducing by 4. Killing Zetalpa is better value.

Wait, do I need to? If I take 17, I'm at 2. Then Spine (7/7) kills Stoic at 8. That's still lethal. And I have Slobad + Trading Post to protect Spine from any removal.

I'll just take the damage and swing back for lethal. Let me pass.

annotations.actionTaken: Played Darkwater Catacombs and passed without casting any spells or developing the board, despite having multiple castable cards and available mana.
annotations.betterLine: Play Darkwater Catacombs, then cast Nihil Spellbomb (1 mana) to have graveyard exile ready, Fellwar Stone (2 mana) for ramp, and potentially Master Transmuter (4 mana with Catacombs) to start generating artifact value. Developing the board is critical when facing Zetalpa.

annotations.description: Gem3P Stoic is at 8 life and has Zetalpa on board as the only real threat. Kimi25 Vet has Bedevil in hand which can destroy Zetalpa (or any creature/artifact/planeswalker), but instead cast Trading Post, a slow value engine. Meanwhile, Stoic's Zetalpa is indestructible so Bedevil can't actually destroy it - but more importantly, Kimi25 Vet has Geth, Lord of the Vault in hand (costs 4BB) and has access to enough mana lands to potentially cast it. With GPT52 Villain's massive graveyard full of powerful creatures (Cairn Wanderer, Cataclysmic Gearhulk, Archon of Valor's Reach, Vampire Nighthawk, etc.), Geth would be an extremely powerful play. However, looking at available mana - Kimi25 has Shadowblood Ridge, Mountain, Drossforge Bridge, Island, Reliquary Tower, Machine God's Effigy, Myriad Landscape, Ichor Wellspring - that's only about 6-7 mana sources and Geth costs 4BB which requires two black. The real issue is that Nihil Spellbomb should have been considered to exile GPT52 Villain's graveyard (preventing Stoic from using those resources) or as setup. Trading Post is a 4-mana do-nothing this turn when the game state calls for more impactful plays. Fellwar Stone + Nihil Spellbomb would have been better mana development while keeping interaction available.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Trading Post (4 mana artifact with slow activated abilities)
annotations.betterLine: Cast Fellwar Stone (2 mana) for ramp plus Nihil Spellbomb (1 mana) as graveyard interaction, or cast Fellwar Stone plus hold up Bedevil mana for interaction, setting up to cast Geth next turn with proper mana development.

annotations.description: Villain sacrificed their only mana rock while having only 4 lands and already holding 8 cards (forcing a discard). At 3 life facing Zetalpa, they needed mana more than cards - keeping Commander's Sphere would have helped cast expensive spells like Sunblast Angel (6 mana) or multiple spells in future turns. The drawn card led to discarding Swiftfoot Boots, gaining minimal value.
annotations.actionTaken: Sacrificed Commander's Sphere to draw a card, then had to discard Swiftfoot Boots to hand size
annotations.betterLine: Keep Commander's Sphere as a mana source to help cast expensive spells like Mimic Vat or Cultivate next turn, since hand was already full of cards
